rv.q: It is both a beautifully clear production and one which, through the alternate casting, adds to the bottomless mystery of Pinter's play.
One of the theatrical treats of the year would be to see Old Times twice, with each of the casting arrangements.
Rickson's production charts all these shifting tonal alliances with exquisite good taste...

cn.t: Ian Rickson's production reunites him with Kristin Scott Thomas for a brilliantly clear take on Pinter's memory play, with Thomas and Lia Williams alternating roles to fascinating effect.
